about: iverilog dashboard tests: MB on disk per simulated second for each debug flag combination (key: the flags, sorted, joined by +; '' = none). kept = FST + .log.gz + .dash.log + hex dumps after the test; peak = the most one test has on disk while it runs (raw .log and VCD before gzip / vcd2fst); build_mb = its own .vvp. Made by dme_klr/iv_disk_usage.sh. Closed-loop (cl_*) rates; the 1 s measurement had the open-loop ramp_to_* tests about 15-35% lower, so open-loop estimates run high.

measured.source: full-length run on the Mac: cl_ramp_to_6000_FQS0..7 (40 s each), one flag combination per test, 8 at once, 3 h 28 min; kept and FST from the files it left (FST + .log.gz + .dash.log). peak scaled from the 1 s iv_disk_usage.sh measurement by the FST ratio; wall assumes all 8 started together
